description: Rebuild the school_result_slip renderer (src/sars/templates/school_result_slip.py) as a fixed-layout, exact-page-size, correct-page-count report. Reference: S1051-MKOLANI SECONDARY SCHOOL (792x612 landscape, 13 pages). It currently reflows to A4 and produces the wrong page count (~21 pages). Replace the A4 path with the slip's own Letter @page and 13-page pagination, preserving the recovered pale panel wash (#92cddc) as fixed chrome. Independent of the other rebuild features.
steps: Read reference geometry for S1051-MKOLANI SECONDARY SCHOOL via extract_document(pair.pdf, pair.html): 13 pages, each page width/height, the identity/division-summary/candidate-list/performance table geometries, per-cell spans and Style, and the page background/panel colour.

Rewrite school_result_slip.py to emit @page{size:792pt 612pt;margin:0} and position its blocks (identity, division summary, candidate list, performance tables) at recovered coordinates with recovered column widths and per-row heights (schools_rank.py pattern), replacing styling.document()/fit_scale() A4.
Paginate to 13 pages, breaking the candidate list where the reference breaks; ensure no candidate rows are dropped.
Preserve the recovered panel wash (#92cddc) behind content as fixed chrome, real fonts, and per-cell washes keyed to recovered fills.
Regenerate with `uv run sars data` then `uv run sars template --only "S1051-MKOLANI SECONDARY SCHOOL"`.
Measure with cell_diff (aim 0 logical mismatches) and pixel_diff (no DIMENSION MISMATCH; record visible%).
acceptance_criteria: S1051-MKOLANI SECONDARY SCHOOL renders at 792x612 landscape with 13 pages; pixel_diff runs without DIMENSION MISMATCH.
No candidate rows are lost relative to the reference.
cell_diff logical mismatch count and pixel_diff visible% recorded honestly.
verification: uv run python tools/cell_diff.py "S1051-MKOLANI SECONDARY SCHOOL" --template -v
uv run python tools/pixel_diff.py "S1051-MKOLANI SECONDARY SCHOOL" --template
findings:
DONE. Branch regenerate-fresh-output. Rebuilt src/sars/templates/school_result_slip.py from the A4 reflow path (styling.document()+fit_scale) into a FIXED-LAYOUT, self-contained renderer matching schools_rank.py/generic_fixed.py: it emits @page{size:792pt 612pt;margin:0}, positions every block with position:absolute at recovered coordinates/column widths, and paginates to the reference's own 13 pages. Every CSS rule is emitted on ONE physical line to dodge the Sheet.extend multi-line-dedup bug FEAT-004 found. No other renderer touched; RENDERERS registry unchanged (slip already mapped).

RECOVERED GEOMETRY (via sars.extract.extract_document(pair.pdf, pair.html), Path args, from sources.select('S1051')[0]): 13 pages, all 792x612 landscape Letter. Page 1 = pale #92cddc panel (17.4,54.2,764.5,549.7) + 5-line masthead (8.3pt bold, ~13pt pitch) + 'DIVISION PERFORMANCE SUMMARY' title + the F/M/T division-summary table (origin 136.9,146.2; cols SEX/I/II/III/IV/0 with recovered #ffffcc/#d2fce6/#e6b8b7 fills) + the candidate-list header and the first 25 candidates. Pages 2-11 = candidate continuation, split 38/38/38/38/38/38/38/38/38 then 13 (page 1 carries 25) = 380 candidates total; the reference brackets the table with thin cyan margin columns (17.4->44.2 and 749.3->764.5) which are reproduced as panel-wash margin cells so the recovered 9-column lattice matches. Page 12 = second #92cddc panel (17.4,54.2,764.5,389.5) carrying the registration/division summary and the subject-performance-and-ranking table stacked at recovered origins; page 13 = the subject grading-performance summary.

NO DROPPED ROWS: candidate row pitch is expressed as line-height on the cells (12.5pt, tuned so 38 rows span 56.9->534.3pt matching the reference 12.97pt pitch and never wrap/drift), NOT a <tr> height, per README, so WeasyPrint drops no candidate row across the 13 pages. Detailed-subjects cells stay on one line at a hair-smaller font (6.3pt) so long rows do not wrap and push the page down. Repeated adjacent header paths (GPA, COMPETENCY) are merged into a single colspan body cell so their value is emitted once (not glued to its neighbour as a duplicate token). ROW/TOKEN-LOSS CHECK: all 380 distinct candidate CNOs render (S1051-0001..0380); tools/template_audit.py reports doc similarity 99.60%, pages 13->13, extra=1 ('SUBJE', a clipped chrome header fragment on the grading-summary group cell).

CELL_DIFF (tools/cell_diff.py --template): GRAND TOTAL 951 logical mismatches. Continuation candidate pages (2-11) are near-perfect (only 2 span diffs each, the cyan margin cells). The residual is concentrated in: (a) page-1 candidate table recovered as (26,7) vs reference (26,9) - the reference draws internal vertical rules at 136.9 and 349.5 that split NAME/DETAILED, but a WeasyPrint colspan-2 cell draws no internal rule, so the extractor recovers 7 columns and every column past NAME shifts by one (~155 text + 26 span); (b) the three performance tables on pages 12-13, whose reference models a 22-column merged lattice plus a 7-row EXAMINATION CENTRE OVERALL summary table that is ABSENT FROM THE EXTRACTED DATA (see below), shifting the table alignment. These are structural extractor-vs-colspan artifacts, not data errors (cf. FEAT-004/005 which accepted the same class).

UPSTREAM EXTRACTION GAP (documented, out of scope): 13 lost token KINDS ['/','24.34','387','4.2111','AVERAGE','CANDIDATES','CC','COUNCIL','COUNCILWISE','OVERALL','PASSED','RANKING','REGIONALWISE'] all belong to page 12's 'EXAMINATION CENTRE OVERALL PERFORMANCE' summary table (REGION/COUNCIL/TOTAL PASSED CANDIDATES/AVERAGE/GPA 4.2111/RANKING COUNCILWISE 61/64/REGIONALWISE 369/387). That table is a label:value block that sars.extract_data._performance_table drops (its rows are not iterated as data rows), so it never reaches the SchoolResultSlip schema (grep of the data JSON confirms 0 occurrences of 4.2111/24.34/COUNCILWISE). The renderer emits everything present in slip.performance; recovering that table would require changing extract_data.py, which the briefing scopes out ('keep other paths untouched') and which prior features documented as an extraction-layer gap.

PIXEL_DIFF (tools/pixel_diff.py --template): NO DIMENSION MISMATCH on any of the 13 pages (all rasterise at 792x612). Honest visible% (max RGB delta > 8) per page: p1 78.48, p2 71.13, p3 71.41, p4 71.45, p5 71.22, p6 71.25, p7 71.25, p8 71.48, p9 71.38, p10 71.44, p11 89.74, p12 64.22, p13 81.17 (mean ~73%). The overlay confirms the candidate rows align row-for-row after the line-height pitch was tuned; the residual is WeasyPrint-vs-original antialiasing/font-metric drift in the dense DETAILED SUBJECTS column (and the #92cddc panel edges), which is not fully eliminable - NOT pixel-identical, as expected.

VERIFICATION (uv run): measure_all.py -> S1051 792x612, 13 pages, SIZE=YES PAGES=YES; totals now 19/19 size + 19/19 page-count (S1051 was the last non-matching report). ruff check src/sars/templates/school_result_slip.py -> All checks passed. python -m pytest -q -> 42 passed (no stale A4 assertion for the slip existed; none needed changing). Conversion path sars verify -> 19/19 documents pass, mean text similarity 100.00%. Other renderers untouched (measure_all unchanged for all non-slip reports). pytest requires `uv sync --extra dev` first.
